questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 03 Question 1: A body of mass m moving with velocity v undergoes a 1D perfectly elastic head-on collision with an identical stationary body of mass m. What are their velocities after collision?
options: First body comes to rest, second moves with velocity v
Both bodies move together with velocity v/2
First body rebounds with velocity -v, second stays at rest
Both bodies rebound with velocities -v/2 and +v/2
questions.correctAnswer: First body comes to rest, second moves with velocity v
questions.solution: In head-on elastic collision of equal masses, velocities are exchanged completely: v1 = 0, v2 = v.
questions.sourceLocator: NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch 06 Sections & Exercises
